description: Carried the loaf clear of the notch, and counted two turns of the sand-glass.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Served the boiled beef, took the threepence, and refused to measure the loaf.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Got off the bench and stayed in the doorway.
name: Gib

description: Said the unmeasured loaf was smaller than Christmas's.
name: Gillis Verbeke
